dependency_boundary.rule: Predecessor state blocks leaf and phase closure, not reversible preflight preparation in this explicitly authorized direct-session lane.
automatic_after_dependencies: refresh the live owner-wide census and candidate identity digest
bind merged C02 census and classification receipts
refresh demand and readiness evidence at exact repository heads
materialize private candidate details only in sanctioned private custody
run the same synthetic drill suite against the integrated templates
never_automatic: select binding legal or economic terms
grant credentials, data, rights, or production access
transfer repository, IP, data, domain, or account custody
close any PSP-P13 leaf or phase

live_sources.use: Formal P02 closure and accepted estate-evidence baseline.
Two-pass owner-wide denominator, organization roster, visibility counts, and private-facts custody contract.
Public-safe role, maturity, visibility, relevance, and uncertainty policy over the census denominator.

candidate_inventory.owner_scope: authenticated owner plus every organization returned by the live GitHub owner census
candidate_inventory.identity_rule: Each owner-independent product-ledger key must resolve to exactly one currently owned repository.
candidate_inventory.two_pass_rule: Two consecutive complete live censuses must have identical owner, organization, repository, and product-candidate identity sets.
candidate_inventory.public_projection: Public repositories may be named; private candidates receive opaque per-snapshot identifiers only.
candidate_inventory.private_projection: Private names, descriptions, topics, URLs, timestamps, and owner-specific row identities remain in process and are never written to this public package.

evidence_tiers.meaning: No approved demand evidence; a bounded next experiment is mandatory.
Public attention signal such as stars or watchers; no adoption inference.
Public reuse signal such as forks; no willingness-to-pay inference.
Consented problem or usage evidence with a dated primary receipt.
Qualified buying or operating intent with a dated primary receipt.
Observed paid or transferred operation with a contract-safe outcome receipt.

rules: Repository volume, a homepage, an internal deployment, and owner activity are not demand evidence.
Private candidates receive E0 in the public projection unless a separately approved private receipt proves a higher tier.
Metadata-only evidence can never cross the transfer floor.
Every E0-E2 candidate carries a next experiment and stop condition.

dimensions.required_proof: Dated deployment or runtime receipt; homepage presence is intent only.
Security review, dependency posture, and secret boundary.
Data classes, retention, deletion, and processing boundary.
Ownership, license, contributor, and repository-custody chain.
Telemetry plus tested rollback, revocation, and restore route.
Named maintainer, response window, and bounded maintenance estimate.

rules: Missing evidence scores zero; absence is never upgraded by inference.
The metadata screen is discovery evidence and cannot claim reproducible build, test, deploy, security, or custody readiness.
Any unresolved IP, data, credential, or rollback boundary makes the candidate non-transferable.

hard_declines: requests credentials, production data, IP rights, or customer access before the corresponding gate
rejects auditability, revocation, termination, or return obligations
conceals a material conflict or cannot establish lawful operating capacity
human_review: unresolved conflict, independence, legal-capacity, sanctions, or beneficial-ownership question
score conflicts with a reference or diligence finding
proposed exception to access, data, economics, or return policy

requirements: no external act without its gate
E3 or stronger primary demand evidence

economic_fields: cash runway and owner time runway
economics_and_kill_rules.public_amount_policy: No private price, cost, runway, valuation, equity, or revenue-share amount is stored in this public preflight.
park_rules: No approved demand evidence after two bounded experiments.
Maintenance or security burden remains larger than the downside-tested value case.
Custody, licensing, contributor, data, or return ownership remains unresolved.
kill_rules: Unlawful, deceptive, unsafe, or consent-incompatible operating model.
Material security or data harm cannot be bounded or remediated.
No credible owner or return path exists before custody would change.

structure_options.description: Owner retains IP and custody; operator receives a narrow, revocable operating license.
structure_options.economics: Fixed or variable operating consideration stays private until approved.
structure_options.return: License ends, access is revoked, owner custody persists, and certified deletion/return receipts are required.

structure_options.description: Owner retains IP; operator earns a reviewed share only on defined collected value.
structure_options.economics: Define gross-to-net waterfall, attribution, reserves, audit, payment timing, caps/floors, and clawback privately.
structure_options.return: Accrued obligations reconcile; future authority stops; assets, data, and access return under the signed clause.

structure_options.description: A separately governed venture may earn rights or equity only through objective milestones.
structure_options.economics: Valuation, dilution, vesting, governance, repurchase, and tax treatment require owner and qualified-counsel approval.
structure_options.return: Unvested rights lapse; licensed assets and access return; surviving obligations remain explicit.

structure_options.description: Operator manages a bounded function while repository, IP, domain, account, and data custody remain with the owner.
structure_options.economics: Management fee or performance consideration remains private and approval-gated.
structure_options.return: Mandate ends; temporary access is revoked; runbooks, records, and in-flight work return to owner custody.

structure_options.description: A synthetic or isolated trial creates no transfer and grants no continuing rights.
structure_options.economics: Trial budget, option consideration, and conversion terms remain private and non-binding until approved.
structure_options.return: Trial expires automatically; all temporary artifacts and access are revoked or returned with a receipt.

stages.exit: criteria match; no contact from this preflight
identity, capacity, references, conflicts, and sanctions checks complete
scorecard, security, data, and economics review complete
synthetic acceptance and denial paths pass
HG-OPERATOR-TERMS and HG-CONTRACT are satisfied outside automation
decision date and complete telemetry reached

bounded_pilot.synthetic_rehearsal: Uses invented product/operator records, invented data, no credentials, no rights, no production access, and no representation of human acceptance.

repository, IP, data, domain, credential, and restore custody

score challenge, conflict review, and lifecycle audit

cadence.scope: candidate evidence, experiment, park, and kill queue
operator performance, economics, access, custody, and return readiness
security, data, ownership, conflict, missed threshold, or terms breach
rubrics, structures, counsel review, portfolio policy, and archived evidence

institutional_governance.template_replay_rule: The complete synthetic lifecycle must replay without a real operator, client data, private repository name, credential, signed term, or production action.

human_gates.preflight_action: Templates remain draft and no structure is selected.
